analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 trading sessions. Today, RSI moved from 33.8→31.3→41.1→41.4, showing a continued attempt to exit oversold and enter the neutral zone. MACD histogram shifted from continued worsening to improving. After a +7.45% daily move, subsequent declines and consolidation indicate a sideways trend. Overall trend reversal signals remain weak, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
